entities.summary: Sergei Chikalkin is a Russian former professional basketball player. The 1.96 m 95 kg shooting guard is known for his long-range shooting accuracy. Started his career as a pro in 1995 with BK Samara. Chikalkin has played in Russia, Italy and Ukraine. He won national championships in each country he played. He last played with CSK VSS Samara.
